title: Rush Charge on Today's Shipment (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Tariff.** Under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program the rush charge is the schedule's expedited shipping fee, charged once for the shipment going out today, rounded to the cent half up.

## Points of the tariff

- **Once per shipment.** One rush charge covers the whole shipment going out today, however many item lines it holds.
- **The shipment going out today.** The item lines on the enrollment with today's ship date make up today's shipment.
- **Paid by card.** The charge is taken from the card on file, never from coverage.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

Taking a schedule whose expedited shipping fee is 14.95: a shipment going out today with three item lines carries one rush charge of 14.95. A shipment with one item line carries the same 14.95.
